titleEn: Canadian firms launch world's earliest in-ovo egg sexing system
titleZh: 加拿大企业推出全球最早鸡胚性别鉴定系统
summaryZh: 加拿大三家公司合作商业化全球最早的鸡胚性别鉴定系统，利用高光谱成像技术在孵化第4天即可无损确定胚胎性别，早于现有任何技术。该系统计划于2026年底或2027年初全球上市，可规模化应用于各种规模的孵化场，有助于提高孵化效率、减少资源消耗，是家禽孵化管理领域的重大突破。
featuredReason: 该技术将高光谱成像与AI算法结合，在孵化第4天实现无损性别鉴定，大幅提升孵化效率并减少资源浪费，是智慧畜牧在禽业落地的重要标杆，值得关注其商业化进程与技术细节。
contentFull:
In-ovo sexing
 

 

 
 
 Canadian firms launch world's earliest in-ovo egg sexing system
 

 Hyperspectral technology determines sex from day four of incubation

 

 
 
 
 
 1 July 2026
 
 

 
 
 
 1 minute read
 
 

 
 
 
 By: Global Ag Media 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 North America

 

 

 

 

 Three companies have partnered to commercialise a Canadian-developed in-ovo egg sexing system capable of determining the sex of chick embryos as early as the fourth day of incubation, earlier than any other technology currently on the market, Canadian Egg Technologies announced.

SANOVO Technology Group, Canadian Egg Technologies (CET) and MatrixSpec Solutions will support a global commercial launch late this year or early 2027. The system uses hyperspectral imaging to make accurate, non-destructive sex determinations without damaging the egg, and is designed to scale across hatcheries of all sizes.

"Egg sexing technology is one of the most significant advances in hatchery management in a generation, and this technology sets the benchmark," said Michael Midskov, group CEO of SANOVO Technology Group. "Bringing this to market through a partnership that combines Canadian innovation with SANOVO Technology Group's global infrastructure is exactly the kind of collaboration that moves the industry forward."

"This technology was built from the ground up to be practical — not just scientifically impressive, but deployable for hatcheries everywhere," said Michael Ngadi, CEO of MatrixSpec Solutions.CET is a collaboration between Egg Farmers of Ontario and Egg Farmers of Canada. The partnership said earlier sex determination allows hatcheries to dedicate more incubator capacity to viable female eggs and reduces resource consumption across the hatch cycle.

translationZh:
三家公司合作将加拿大开发的鸡胚性别鉴定系统商业化，该系统能够在孵化第4天确定鸡胚性别，比目前市场上任何其他技术都更早，加拿大蛋品技术公司宣布。

SANOVO科技集团、加拿大蛋品技术公司（CET）和MatrixSpec Solutions公司将支持该系统于今年年底或2027年初在全球商业发布。该系统利用高光谱成像技术进行准确、无损的性别鉴定，不会损坏鸡蛋，并设计为可扩展至各种规模的孵化场。

“蛋鸡性别鉴定技术是一代人中孵化场管理领域最重要的进步之一，这项技术树立了标杆，”SANOVO科技集团首席执行官迈克尔·米兹科夫表示。“通过结合加拿大创新与SANOVO科技集团全球基础设施的合作伙伴关系将其推向市场，正是推动行业向前发展的那种合作。”

“这项技术从零开始就注重实用性——不仅在科学上令人印象深刻，而且可在任何孵化场部署，”MatrixSpec Solutions首席执行官迈克尔·恩加迪表示。CET是安大略省蛋农协会和加拿大蛋农协会的合作项目。该合作伙伴关系表示，更早的性别鉴定使孵化场能够将更多孵化器容量用于可孵化的雌性蛋，并减少整个孵化周期的资源消耗。
